system.description: When you spend an hour or so thoroughly exploring an area (whether directly, through surveillance footage or a blueprint, or questioning people familiar with the area) no larger than a long distance in diameter, you can ask the GM one question about the area's defensive systems and procedures. The GM must answer you truthfully. For example, you could ask how often guards pass by a particular spot, what the guards are armed with (if anything), or if there are electronic or magical alarms. This ability resets when you use a ten-hour recovery. Effort: Ask an additional question. Action to initiate; one hour to complete.
